newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil court seizes assets of Morgan Stanley exec.
newsitem.headline: Brazil court seizes assets of Morgan Stanley exec.

text.p: A court seized all Brazilian assets of Morgan Stanley Group Inc executive Francisco Gros following a request to have former board directors of failed BFC Banco repay the bank's debts, a judge said Monday.
Gros, a former Brazilian Central Bank president and former minority owner and board member of BFC, was not immediately available for comment.

Judge Newton Campos de Medeiros, who is presiding over the case in Rio de Janeiro, said the court decided to seize the property of Gros and other BFC directors in response to a request by the Central Bank.
"The board of directors should assume BFC's debt to the Central Bank," Medeiros told Reuters.
Former BFC board members may appeal the decision, Medeiros said.
BFC Banco was liquidated by the Central Bank in December 1995.
